messages:
sophia: Heads-up — console SLO preview is showing 95% but the API effective threshold is 94.5 after quota/quiet-window smoothing. Spotted during the canary rollout, UX looks inconsistent. Repro and payload below.

sophia: ```json
POST /api/v1/slo-preview
{
  "expression": "p95(latency) < 200",
  "adjustments": { "quiet_window_factor": 0.95, "tenant_quota_adj": 0.995 }
}
```

tom: Is the 94.5 coming from quiet_window_factor * tenant_quota_adj? We apply smoothing in routing policy yes, but do we render the adjusted value anywhere in the card?

jordan: We show the computed number in the small badge but the tooltip still prints the original expression. Mismatch is confusing — people think the SLO is p95<200 while the system enforces a slightly different limit.

linda: Also noticed the preview telemetry lacks a preview_tag (e.g. preview=api) so we can't filter rollout noise later. I'll file a ticket.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: Canary 3/7 completed for slo-preview-service — no deploy errors.

sophia: Proposal: API response for preview should include both raw_expression and effective_threshold (number) plus a short explain list describing adjustments, e.g. ["quiet_window: -5%","quota_adj: -0.5%"]. That way console can clearly show both values. Any objections?

tom: No objection. One ask: make the explain entries machine-friendly (key:value) in addition to human text so the console can render charts. Also add a field adjustments_hash to help cache lookups.

jordan: LGTM. Two caveats: cap explain array length and strip any tenant-identifying metadata from explain entries.

linda: I'll take ownership of adding preview=api telemetry and updating the tooltip text to show computed value + a hover explanation. Will aim for a PR by EOD.

sophia: Thanks — I'll update the API RFC to add effective_threshold, explain[], adjustments_hash and changelog. Will ping infra to add short retention for preview telemetry. :thumbsup:
